decisions.description: The source leaves absolute material and section values to the author appendix. Freeze Q355 E=206000 MPa, nu=0.3, G=E/[2(1+nu)] MPa and density=7850 kg/m3; B1 is 0.3 by 0.6 m. Where B2/B3 are unspecified rectangles, use 0.3 by 0.7 m and 0.35 by 0.8 m respectively, with every A/Iy/Iz/J explicitly supplied. Source-prescribed inertia ratios override these optional rectangle definitions.
Point-load and displacement observation stations are connected nodes, without additional planar restraints or masses.
Source and structural authoring checks do not establish native execution, independent numerical truth or blind input acceptance; all remain pending.

The initial public table omits the final nodal-moment load record, generic moment unit and model unit_system. Only the known right-span UDL is numeric. The final moment unit is revealed in turn 2 only.
The source omits the direction of the 6 kN/m right-span UDL. The appendix freezes downward global -Z; the positive-Y end moment follows the source right-hand-rule clarification.
